LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 12.1.1 PUNCTUATION AND VOCABULARY

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Technology Suggested vocabulary mobile phone, tablet, charge, power, battery, ca
Topic 12.1: Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Punctuation and Vocabulary
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Punctuation and Vocabulary, part of Technology Suggested vocabulary mobile phone, tablet, charge, power, battery, ca in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should we listen attentively when other people are talking?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1.  Listen attentively for the target letter sounds combinations (gr- pr- , -ew’) in different words from an audio recording.  Say words with the target letter sound combination and record using digital devices. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication.  Listen to the new words in short sentences/short paragraphs/teacher-read stories and write them down,  In purposive groups, collaboratively give the meaning of the words based on the context

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1.  Listen attentively for the target letter sounds combinations (gr- pr- , -ew’) in different words from an audio recording.  Say words with the target letter sound combination and record using digital devices. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication.  Listen to the new words in short sentences/short paragraphs/teacher-read stories and write them down,  In purposive groups, collaboratively give the meaning of the words based on the context

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Punctuation and Vocabulary together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Digital literacy- learner’s ability to interact with technology is enhanced as they use digital devices to listen to and record
